log.emptyHint: No readings yet, click Log Reading to record
log.tipLogReading: Log Reading Snapshot current experiment state: RF frequency, field, Vm (target & healthy), selectivity, temperature, disruption ratios. Auto-logged on lysis events.
log.tipExportCsv: Export CSV Download all log entries as a 20-column table. Columns: # · Time · Session · Freq (kHz) · Field (V/cm) · Medium · Target · T-Vm (mV) · H-Vm (mV) · Selectivity · T-Ratio (%) · H-Ratio (%) · T-Temp (°C) · H-Temp (°C) · Orientation (°) · H-Re[K] · T-Re[K] · H-f_cross (kHz) · T-f_cross (kHz) · Event
log.tipClearLog: Clear Log Remove all readings from this session. This action cannot be undone.
log.tipExportMethods: Export Methods Text Download a publication-ready methods paragraph for the most recently logged reading. Includes cell types, field parameters, calculated Vm, DR, and model citations.
log.tipThSession: Session: Experiment Session Name The session name active at the time this reading was logged. Changing the session name mid-experiment is recorded here, allowing entries from multiple sessions to coexist in one log.
log.tipThNumber: #, Entry Index Sequential reading number (newest first).
log.tipThTime: Time: Timestamp Local time (HH:MM:SS) when the reading was logged.
log.tipThFreq: Freq: RF Frequency Broadcast frequency at time of reading. Below fc → quasi-DC, Vm at maximum. Above fc → Schwan roll-off reduces Vm.
log.tipThField: Field: Applied Electric Field Field intensity at time of reading. Vm scales linearly with E (Schwan eq.).
log.tipThTargetVm: T-Vm: Target Transmembrane Potential Peak voltage across target cell membrane via Schwan equation. Higher → more disruption.
log.tipThHealthyVm: H-Vm: Healthy Transmembrane Potential Peak voltage across healthy reference membrane. Keep below 50% of threshold for safe operation.
log.tipThSel: Sel×, Therapeutic Index (TI) DR_T / DR_H, disruption ratio of target divided by healthy cell. TI accounts for pulse envelope factor, temperature-corrected thresholds, and H-FIRE multiplier, so TI differs from the raw Vm ratio when those corrections are non-unity. ≥ {strong}× Strong selectivity window {marginal} - {strong}× Marginal window < {marginal}× Non-selective
log.tipThEvent: Event Type manual, snapshot triggered by user lysis, membrane disrupted (auto-logged)
log.tipThTargetDR: T-DR%: Target Disruption Ratio Lorentzian disruption ratio at resonant frequency. DR = (E / E_thr) × L(f, f_res, Q). ≥ 85%: capsid disruption threshold reached. 50-84%: subthreshold acoustic stress.
log.tipThHealthyDR: H-DR%: Healthy Cell Disruption Ratio Mammalian cells have no rigid-shell acoustic resonance. Schwan Vm → 0 at GHz (ωτ ≫ 1). Value is near zero, confirming healthy tissue is unperturbed in resonance mode.
log.tipThDepH: Re[K] H, Clausius-Mossotti Factor (Healthy) Real part of the CM factor for the healthy cell. Re[K] > 0 → pDEP (attracted to field maxima) Re[K] < 0 → nDEP (repelled from field maxima) Re[K] = 0 → crossover frequency f_cross Single-shell sphere model (Gascoyne & Vykoukal 2002).
log.tipThDepT: Re[K] T, Clausius-Mossotti Factor (Target) Real part of the CM factor for the target cell. Re[K] > 0 → pDEP (attracted to field maxima) Re[K] < 0 → nDEP (repelled from field maxima) Re[K] = 0 → crossover frequency f_cross Effective DEP force ∝ Re[K] × (0.5 for CW, dc for pulsed).
log.tipCellFreq: RF Frequency: {freq} kHz At the time this reading was logged. Below fc → quasi-DC Vm; above fc → Schwan roll-off decreases Vm.
log.tipCellField: Applied Field: {field} V/cm Electric field intensity at log time. Vm scales linearly with E (Schwan equation).
log.tipCellTargetVm: Target Vm: {vm} mV Preset: {preset} Disruption ratio at log time: {ratio}% > 85% → lysis countdown armed (irreversible EP) 50-85% → reversible EP (membrane permeabilised) < 50% → sub-electroporation
log.tipCellHealthyVm: Healthy Vm: {vm} mV Disruption ratio at log time: {ratio}% Keep below 50% of healthy threshold for a selective protocol window. > 50% → collateral membrane stress
log.tipCellSel: Selectivity: {sel}× (Vm_T / Vm_H) Target temperature: {targetTemp} °C Healthy temperature: {healthyTemp} °C Higher selectivity = more target disruption per unit healthy exposure.
log.tipCellTRatio: Target disruption ratio: {ratio}% Vm_target / V_threshold. Above 85% arms the lysis countdown. 85 - 100% → irreversible EP, lysis armed 50 - 85% → reversible EP, membrane permeabilised < 50% → sub-electroporation
log.tipCellHRatio: Healthy disruption ratio: {ratio}% Vm_healthy / V_threshold — margin of safety for collateral damage. Keep below 50% to avoid reversible EP in healthy tissue.
log.tipCellSession: Session: {name} Entry #{id} was logged under this session name. Rename the session in the Experiment Lab header to track different protocol variants within the same log.
log.tipCellDepH: Re[K] H: {k}, Healthy cell Clausius-Mossotti factor > 0 → pDEP (cell drawn toward field maxima) < 0 → nDEP (cell repelled from field maxima) = 0 → crossover frequency f_cross
log.tipCellDepT: Re[K] T: {k}, Target cell Clausius-Mossotti factor > 0 → pDEP (cell drawn toward field maxima) < 0 → nDEP (cell repelled from field maxima) = 0 → crossover frequency f_cross
log.tipCellLysis: ⚡ Lysis event Target membrane irreversibly disrupted. Auto-logged when lysis countdown completed.
log.tipCellManual:
Manual snapshot
Logged by user at this timestamp.
log.tipDose: Cumulative Specific Energy Dose [J/kg] Running integral of the specific absorption rate (SAR) over the session: Dose = ∫ SAR × dc × dt SAR = σ_i · α² · E² · wf / ρ (W/kg) α = 3σ_e / (2σ_e + σ_i) (internal field factor) wf = 0.5 (CW) · 1.0 (pulsed) Dose accumulates only when the field is active. ICNIRP 2020 occupational whole-body limit: 0.4 W/kg SAR. This display tracks target-cell dose, not whole-body average. Reset when the log is cleared.
